description: Phase 6ba gate — positional ORDER BY. Compile-time rewrite: integer-literal order-by-term refers to Nth projection column. No new opcodes. max_invariant=43 unchanged.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY 1;
CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
SELECT a, b FROM t ORDER BY 2;
SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY 1 DESC;

cases.name: positional-on-computed-projection
cases.description: ORDER BY 1 sorts by the computed expression, not the underlying column.

program.sql: SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY 1;

cases.name: positional-on-case-expression
cases.description: The original select1.test:94 shape: CASE expression in projection, ORDER BY 1 sorts the CASE result numerically.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER, c INTEGER);
SELECT CASE WHEN c > 110 THEN a*2 ELSE b*10 END FROM t ORDER BY 1;

cases.name: positional-multi-term
cases.description: ORDER BY 1, 2 — two-term sort by projection 1 then 2.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
SELECT a, b FROM t ORDER BY 1, 2;

cases.name: positional-with-column-ref-mixed
cases.description: ORDER BY 1, b — first positional then explicit column.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
SELECT a, b FROM t ORDER BY 1, b;
SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY 5;
SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY 0;

cases.name: not-positional-expression-stays-expression
cases.description: ORDER BY 1+0 is NOT positional (AST is BinaryOp, not IntLiteral). Evaluates as constant 1 per row → stable no-op, insertion order preserved.

program.sql: SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY 1+0;

cases.name: not-positional-negative-stays-expression
cases.description: ORDER BY -1 is UnaryOp(Neg, Int(1)) — NOT positional. Evaluates as constant -1, no-op sort.

program.sql: SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY -1;

cases.name: positional-with-aggregate-projection
cases.description: Aggregate in projection + ORDER BY 1 — sorts by the aggregate value across groups.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (g INTEGER, v INTEGER);
SELECT g, SUM(v) FROM t GROUP BY g ORDER BY 2;

cases.name: positional-with-limit
cases.description: ORDER BY 1 LIMIT — sort then limit.

program.sql: SELECT a FROM t ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 3;

cases.name: positional-with-star-projection
cases.description: SELECT * with positional ORDER BY — star expands to FROM-clause column list; ORDER BY N refers to the Nth declared column.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);

cases.name: positional-on-star-out-of-range
cases.description: SELECT * FROM t ORDER BY N where N > (number of declared columns) must raise COMPILE_ORDER_BY_POSITION_OUT_OF_RANGE.

program.sql: CREATE TABLE t (a INTEGER, b INTEGER);
